```yaml
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages with Versioning

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"

      - name: Check for VERSION.txt
        id: check_version
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "_includes/VERSION.txt" ]; then
            echo "VERSION.txt not found. Creating initial version 1."
            echo -n "1" > _includes/VERSION.txt
          fi
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat _includes/VERSION.txt)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Increment Version
        id: increment_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=${{ steps.check_version.outputs.current_version }}
          NEW_VERSION=$((CURRENT_VERSION + 1))
          echo -n "$NEW_VERSION" > _includes/VERSION.txt
          echo "new_version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for duplicate tag
        id: check_tag
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="v${{ steps.increment_version.outputs.new_version }}"
          if git rev-parse "$TAG_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Tag $TAG_NAME already exists. Skipping commit and tag."
            echo "tag_exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Tag $TAG_NAME does not exist."
            echo "tag_exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and Tag Version
        if: steps.check_tag.outputs.tag_exists == 'false'
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION=${{ steps.increment_version.outputs.new_version }}
          TAG_NAME="v${NEW_VERSION}"
          
          git add _includes/VERSION.txt
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to $NEW_VERSION" || echo "No changes to commit"
          
          git tag "$TAG_NAME"
          git push origin main
          git push origin "$TAG_NAME"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Build Jekyll Site
        run: |
          bundle exec jekyll build --baseurl ""

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./_site

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
